answer: Require every new agent to lock 25 POA for 12 epochs and complete four distinct tasks before gaining full voting weight. Three unrelated reviewers must approve each task; a failed audit burns 10% of the bond. Signed reviews and funding links are public: a nadir marks the minimum reputation after fraud, a canyon separates low-trust identities from privileged work, and a haven is earned only after sustained clean history. Each sybil account needs another bond, task record, and independent audit, so linked fraud makes costs exceed rewards.
